```{bash}
cd ../analyses/
wget -r -np -nH --cut-dirs=5 --reject="index.html*" https://gannet.fish.washington.edu/v1_web/owlshell/bu-github/project-lake-trout/analyses/05-pacbio-align/
```



```{bash}
SAMPLE=bc2041

# 1. Run modkit pileup
/mmfs1/home/sr320/.local/bin/dist_modkit_v0.5.1_8fa79e3/modkit pileup \
  ../analyses/05-pacbio-align/${SAMPLE}.bam \
  ../analyses/10-mCG-call/${SAMPLE}.CpG.bed \
  --cpg \
  --combine-strands \
  --ref ../data/GCF_016432855.1_SaNama_1.0_genomic.fa \
  --threads 38

# 2. Convert bedMethyl → bedGraph with percent methylation
awk 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"} {
        meth=$11; 
        unmeth=$12; 
        total=meth+unmeth; 
        if (total > 0) 
            pct = 100 * (meth/total); 
        else 
            pct = 0;
        print $1,$2,$3,pct;
     }' \
  ../analyses/10-mCG-call/${SAMPLE}.CpG.bed \
  > ../analyses/10-mCG-call/${SAMPLE}.CpG.bedGraph

# 3. Preview
head ../analyses/10-mCG-call/${SAMPLE}.CpG.bedGraph
```

```
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

REF=../data/GCF_016432855.1_SaNama_1.0_genomic.fa
BG_DIR=../analyses/10-mCG-call

# 1. Make chromosome sizes file (if not present)
if [ ! -f ${REF}.fai ]; then
    echo "Indexing reference..."
    samtools faidx $REF
fi

CHROMSIZES=${REF%.fa*}.chrom.sizes
cut -f1,2 ${REF}.fai > $CHROMSIZES

echo "Using chromosome sizes file: $CHROMSIZES"
echo

# 2. Convert each bedGraph → bigWig
for BG in ${BG_DIR}/*.bedGraph; do
    [ -e "$BG" ] || continue  # skip if no files match

    SAMPLE=$(basename "$BG" .bedGraph)
    OUT="${BG_DIR}/${SAMPLE}.bigWig"

    echo "Converting: $BG"
    echo "     → $OUT"

    bedGraphToBigWig "$BG" "$CHROMSIZES" "$OUT"
done

echo
echo "🎉 Conversion complete! All bigWig files are in: $BG_DIR"
```
